sources.entry: ONLYOFFICE - Office suite that enables you to manage documents, projects, team and customer relations in one place. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: ONLYOFFICE Docs (formerly Document Server) is a free, self-hostable collaborative online office suite with viewers and editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, forms, PDFs, and diagrams.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the ONLYOFFICE Docs server, which provides browser-based editors for text documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF forms, PDFs, and diagrams. It is described as fully compatible with Office Open XML formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) and supports real-time collaborative editing. The README lists components including a backend server, a conversion core that handles many document formats (DOC, DOCX, ODT, PDF, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, DjVu and others), a JavaScript SDK, a web frontend, spellcheck dictionaries, fonts, and templates. It supports plugins, and the interface is described as available in 46 languages with RTL support. The README says it can be used with third-party sync and share solutions such as Odoo, Moodle, ownCloud, and Seafile. Installation is via Docker image or Linux/Windows packages, and the Community Edition is the AGPL-licensed option.
use_cases: edit docx, xlsx, and pptx files in a browser
real-time co-editing of documents with a team
add an online editor to ownCloud, Seafile, or Moodle
how_to_run: Install ONLYOFFICE Docs using the official Docker image (see the README links to the install guides)
Alternatively, follow the Linux installation guide from the Help Center
Alternatively, follow the Windows installation guide from the Help Center
To build from source, follow the build instructions in the ONLYOFFICE Help Center
notable: Office Open XML compatible editors for text, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, forms, and diagrams
Real-time collaborative editing with comments, chat, and review/track changes
Integrates with sync-and-share platforms such as ownCloud, Seafile, Moodle, and Odoo
Plugin support and a 46-language interface with RTL support
Community Edition licensed under AGPL v3
caveats: The Community Edition is recommended for up to 20 users, per the README's comparison table
Clustering, the admin panel, mobile web editors, and some other features are listed only in the Enterprise or Developer editions, which are proprietary and paid
Building from source is described as detailed in the Help Center, not in the README itself
